description: This file defines the ChainedBlockStream class, which implements a custom PHP stream wrapper for reading data blocks in an OLE (Object Linking and Embedding) compound file format. It provides methods for opening, reading, seeking, and closing streams, and manages internal state related to OLE data blocks.

classes.name: ChainedBlockStream
classes.description: A PHP stream wrapper class for reading data blocks from an OLE compound file, supporting stream operations like open, close, read, seek, EOF, et cetera.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Supports opening the stream, parsing the resource string, locating the specified block within the OLE container, and loading the data into memory.

methods.name: stream_close
methods.description: Closes the stream and cleans up internal state.

methods.name: stream_read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the current position in the data stream.

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached EOF.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the stream pointer.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position within the data stream, supporting different seek modes.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Returns statistics about the stream, currently only size.
